source.method: Disassembly listings from ghidra-cli 12.1.4 and Capstone 5.0.7 were treated as leads. Every instruction sequence, table and string below is confirmed against the pinned bytes by tools/verify_client_music_initiators.py --exe, which also reruns the direct call, jump and data-reference scans.

module.getterRule: Returns the application object plus 0x928, the RaptureSoundModule.
module.boundary: The cluster's own callers pass the module from 0x004d7500. The slot array is addressed only by the immediates in immediateScans.

titleTracks.retryRule: A request that returns false adds one to the counter and the gate skips the request once the counter exceeds the limit.

gate.replay: A zero to one change replays the single cached packet song and mode through 0x004bbb30 and clears the cache.
gate.cachedWhileDisabled: One song and mode pair, the latest request; no queue.
gate.pairing: The gate closes only on a begin that sets +0x180 and reopens only on an end that finds +0x180 set.

cutManager.flagSource: 1 when the target object's id (virtual +0x10) equals the id derived from the ProxyActor name
cutManager.endModeCondition: The release and resume block runs when the dword at +0x1e8 is below 0 or above 1.

beginCallerOwners.0x0061c587: 0x0061c4d0, called by case 0 of the 0x0061c6c0 message handler

cases.0: 0x0061c4d0 stores the message and calls begin 0x00611c30

modeSetter.rule: +0x1e8 becomes the larger of its value and the dword the argument points at
modeSetter.armsEnd: When virtual +0x0c of the object at +0x174 returns true it also sets the dword +0x1e4, which slot 141 tests before it runs the end routine.

cutManager.pairing: Begin returns false at once while +0x180 is set, and otherwise sets +0x180, clears +0x160 and +0x161, zeroes +0x1e8 and closes the gate. End returns at once while +0x180 is clear, and otherwise clears +0x180 after its restore steps.
cutManager.endModeFour: End passes 0 instead of -1 to 0x00610040 when +0x1e8 is 4, and the effect is untraced.

parameters.receiverModes: 7 through 10 write cell 1 with mode minus 7
parameters.driverRule: For the local element, states 0x0f and 0x5b at +0xf0 write cell 0 with 1 when the float at +0x868 times 30.0 exceeds the parameter table value for id 1, else 0, and clear bit 2 of +0x274. Other states replay cell 1 once and set bit 2 of +0x274.

sites.condition: the removed actor equals the local actor at owner +0x17838
the actor equals the local actor at owner +0x17838
the byte at owner +0x54b is clear: the handler sets it, walks the actor map and then resets unconditionally. When the byte is set, the handler clears it, calls 0x004d8080(1) and exits without a reset
sites.toggleByte: owner +0x54b, also set at 0x004daf99 and cleared at 0x004db567 in the application update

sites.condition: state helper 0x004d6a50, reached from 0x004d9980 with id 0xc0000000

ambient.handoffRule: 0x00808430 stores the enable byte into the manager entry only when it is non-zero, and the entry clears it on every update.

install.scope: owner installation of build 2012.09.19.0001, existence, size, SHA-256 and SEDBSSCF magic only
install.sheetBoundary: Column types and block slot counts of the sheet definition documents, not row values. The definitions carry no column names, so the exclusion of a music column rests on the call census.

claims.claim: Every direct call or jump to the music entry points, and every dword reference to them, is enumerated in entries.
The slot array and its cells are addressed only by the listed immediates, so every native start of the two music slots goes through an entry in entries.
The control entry has three callers: the packet receiver, the Lua wrapper and the gate replay.
The boot manager and three bootup phases request resource 0x07fe001c with duration 2000.
PatchPhase requests one of 0x27950015, 0x27950016 and 0x27950017 by a random index, with duration 2000, until a request succeeds or the counter passes 30.
The three title track resources exist on the installation as single-stream SEDBSSCF containers.
PhaseCredit requests 0x07fe003f with duration 0 and releases with duration 2000.
One helper requests 0x07fe0046 with duration 400.
The helper's two call sites lie in the bootup menu flow.
Login, title and credit teardown release with duration 2000.
The cut manager begin closes the gate and the end opens it, replaying one cached packet pair.
RaptureBgmClip slot 1 passes the resource id at clip data +0x20 and the duration at +0x14 to the play routine.
The play routine suspends and swaps the world song once, requests the clip song, and the end routine releases and resumes.
The begin routine, the mode setter and the end routine trace to CutManagerActor slots 157 and 141.
The retail cut scheduler census holds no row for BGMStopClip or BGMVolumeClip.
Two parameter cells are written by modes 7 to 10 and by the CharaElement driver.
The meaning of element states 0x0f and 0x5b and of the parameter values.
The module reset runs on DeleteAllActors or RemoveActor of the local actor, on opcode 0x0004 and from two other sites.
Receiver slot 7 with (0, 500) stops the module's sounds.
Eight functions in the cluster have no call, jump or dword reference.
The zone, region, region parameter, zone group and layout sheet definitions have 1, 1, 3, 6 and 3 integer columns and carry no column names.
No native input from zone, region, layout, time of day, mount or battle start reaches a music request.
LayRaptureEnvSoundClip checks an SE instance type, a time window and string and id conditions, then hands an enable byte to the manager.
EnvironmentSound fades a handle's volume by ticks over 300000.0 over 3.0 or 1.0 per update and drops the enable byte each update.
The environment sound is the layout-scheduled ambient loop.
Which sound a layout object names and the meaning of the clip's string conditions.
Begin is a no-op while the active byte +0x180 is set and end is a no-op while it is clear, so the gate reopens only on an end paired with a begin.
The only traced raise of the mode dword +0x1e8 is the max-assign at 0x0060f401, reached from case 2 of the CutManagerActor slot 157 message handler, and begin writes 0.
The play routine belongs to the same class because it uses the same object fields.
The end routine makes virtual +0x08 and +0x1c calls on the object that 0x0060b280 returns before the mode block.
The +0x1c call is receiver slot 7 0x00441b00, the stop call the module reset makes, here with a non-zero first argument.
Opcode 0x0004 resets the music state only when the byte at owner +0x54b is clear, and otherwise clears it, calls 0x004d8080(1) and exits.
The route from BGMStopClip and BGMVolumeClip to the music entries.
The generic sound request path at 0x007cf320 returns false for resource class 0x07fe.
